transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this pre-job review together because we need to discuss the solvent-recovery trial for the new skid beside the coating area. As you know, we have nine hundred liters of solvent mixture in drums awaiting disposition, and before I can authorize any trial run on production solvent, plant policy requires us to go through this review with process engineering, maintenance, and environmental compliance. I'd like to walk through each element of the standard pre-job procedure: equipment inspection, closed transfer, ventilation verification, vapor monitoring, and documented waste handling. For each one, I need to know current status and what's been completed versus what still needs to be done. Let's start with process engineering -- can you give me an overview of where we stand on the equipment inspection and closed transfer setup?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we go further. I completed a bench compatibility test yesterday, and the results show that only 600 liters of the stored solvent mixture is suitable for this skid. The remaining 300 liters contains a solvent component that the skid's seals are not rated for. This result is still in my lab notebook and hasn't been uploaded to the process file yet, so I'm disclosing it now so we're all working from the same information.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report my pre-use inspection findings. The skid transfer pump seal must be replaced and pressure-tested before operation. The replacement takes exactly 3 hours, and the seal kit is in the maintenance storeroom. I recorded this on a paper inspection sheet that hasn't been entered in the electronic work-order system yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share my permit review findings. I received clarification from the environmental office this morning. This solvent recovery operation requires ventilation of at least 6 air changes per hour, exactly 2 continuously operating LEL monitors, and a hazardous-waste manifest for the incompatible 300 liters that Jonas just identified. I have not yet filed this clarification with the trial paperwork, so I'm disclosing it now so it's on the record for this review.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Upload Jonas's bench compatibility test results from lab notebook to the process file, confirming 600 liters compatible and 300 liters incompatible with skid seals.
Replace skid transfer pump seal using storeroom seal kit (3 hours) and conduct pressure test before operation. Enter paper inspection sheet findings into electronic work-order system.

File environmental office clarification with trial paperwork specifying 6 ACH ventilation minimum, 2 continuous LEL monitors, and hazardous-waste manifest requirement for the 300 liters of incompatible solvent.
Prepare and complete hazardous-waste manifest for the 300 liters of incompatible solvent mixture identified by compatibility testing.
Verify coating area ventilation achieves at least 6 air changes per hour before trial authorization.
Install and verify 2 continuously operating LEL monitors in the recovery skid area before trial authorization.
Verify closed transfer setup is complete and functional after pump seal replacement and pressure test.
